description: Teorainneacha na Gaeltachta Ginearálaithe go 20m. Shainigh Orduithe na Limistéar Gaeltachta, 1956, 1967, 1974 agus 1982 an Ghaeltacht mar 155 Toghroinn nó páirteanna de Thoghranna i gcontaetha Chorcaí, Dhún na nGall, na Gaillimhe, Chiarraí, Mhaigh Eo, na Mí agus Phort Láirge Gaeltacht Boundaries Generalised to 20m. The Gaeltacht Areas Orders, 1956, 1967, 1974 and 1982 defined the Gaeltacht as comprising 155 Electoral Divisions or parts of Electoral Divisions in the counties of Cork, Donegal, Galway, Kerry, Mayo, Meath and Waterford. This dataset is provided by Tailte Éireann

table:columns.description: Easting of the unit centroid in Irish Transverse Mercator (EPSG:2157), in metres.

table:columns.name: CENTROID_Y
table:columns.description: Northing of the unit centroid in Irish Transverse Mercator (EPSG:2157), in metres.
